subject.title: QMD memory indexing can recurse into symlink loops in workspace-visible temp monorepos and fail with ENAMETOOLONG

question: Should OpenClaw resolve #54463 by requiring/probing a fixed QMD version, or by adding an OpenClaw-owned QMD collection ignore/traversal safeguard for supported installs?
rationale: Current upstream QMD appears to disable symlink following, but OpenClaw still documents the limitation and has no local QMD traversal guard, so the right ownership and upgrade contract are maintainer policy choices.

options.title: Version-gate QMD first
options.body: Confirm the issue no longer reproduces with current QMD, then update doctor/docs/version checks and close only if supported installs are protected.

options.title: Add OpenClaw QMD guard
options.body: Wire ignore/no-follow behavior into generated QMD collections or pre-update validation so OpenClaw protects users independent of QMD defaults.

options.title: Keep docs-only workaround
options.body: Leave runtime behavior delegated to QMD and keep the documented workaround for users with risky workspace-visible temp repos.

recommendation.title: Version-gate QMD first
recommendation.body: Confirm the issue no longer reproduces with current QMD, then update doctor/docs/version checks and close only if supported installs are protected.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the assigned issue owner and already made the docs/runtime-boundary distinction in the issue history.
